# Plopjar

> Plopjar is a free physics merge puzzle game that runs in any web browser. Players fling squishy numbered blobs into a glass jar; two blobs with the same number merge into one worth double. It has six modes, a daily jar, 24 puzzle levels, works offline as an installable web app, and has no ads, accounts or tracking. Made by Viz (https://viztf.lol).

Last updated: 2026-11-10. Version 1.7. Play at https://plopjar.viztf.lol/

## Key facts

- Price: free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no premium tier, no sign-up.
- Platforms: any modern browser on iPhone, iPad, Android, Chromebook, Windows, Mac and Linux. Touch, mouse or keyboard (arrow keys aim, Space drops, Esc pauses). No app store download.
- Offline: works without internet after the first visit; can be installed to the home screen (Progressive Web App).
- Privacy: no analytics, no cookies, no third-party requests. Progress is stored only in the browser's localStorage on the player's device and does not sync between devices.
- Genre: number merge / physics drop puzzle, single player. Shares the "matching numbers merge and double" idea with 2048, but blobs are thrown into a jar with physics instead of sliding on a grid.

## Rules

- Grab any of the four blobs on the shelf, slide to aim, release to drop softly, or pull down to throw harder. One shelf swap is allowed after every throw.
- Two matching blobs merge into one worth double (1, 2, 4 ... up to 8,192). Each merge scores the new blob's value times the combo.
- Merges less than about 1.25 seconds apart build a combo; points multiply up to x5.
- The game ends when blobs stay above the dashed line for 3 seconds (except Zen mode).
- Power-ups: merging charges up to 3 charges. Shake jiggles the jar; Pop removes one tapped blob.
- Rainbow blobs are rare wildcards that merge with the first blob they touch; they appear after a 16 blob is made.
- Blob characters by value: 1 Pip, 2 Duo, 4 Bean, 8 Gumdrop, 16 Mochi, 32 Puddin, 64 Jello, 128 Marsh, 256 Big Bun, 512 Wobbles, 1,024 Sir Squish, 2,048 Duchess, 4,096 Moonjelly, 8,192 The Blob.

## Modes

- Classic: the standard jar; highest score.
- Slim: a narrow jar with small blobs (1 to 8); hard.
- Threes: powers of three (1, 3, 9 ... 6,561); three matching blobs must touch to merge.
- Sprint: make a 1,024 blob as fast as possible; result is a time.
- Zen: no game over; overflow pops away.
- Chaos: a rule changes every 25 seconds (low gravity, heavy jelly, wind left or right, bouncy walls, double points).
- Daily jar: one new game per day, identical for every player; daily streaks.
- Jar trail: 24 puzzle levels, each with a goal and a throw limit, rated up to three stars.
- Also: three daily missions, 29 achievements, 8 themes unlocked with stars, game replays at 1x to 8x speed, score sharing.
